keyFindings.description: knownIssueStatus has no supersession fence: a pending in_progress left by a failed PATCH outranks a human's later echoed move (backlog/icebox/todo) until the next resync (<=600 s), so the implementer's completion PATCHes testing over the human's status; round-1 code read the echoed status and wrote nothing, so the delta introduces it. Fix: `const pending = state.pendingStatusWrites[issue]; const echoed = state.issues[issue]?.status; return pending && echoed === pending.statusAtRecord ? pending.status : echoed;` (resync's own retryPendingWrite rule) + one test (echoed backlog, pending {in_progress, statusAtRecord: todo} -> []); update the two knownIssueStatus parentheticals in AGENTS.md and the doc comment. Thread 3999033803.

'if a human's review moved it since' — a review never moves a status; the spawn re-writes whenever the daemon does not yet know in_progress (echo lag), benign duplicate PATCH. Say 'unless the daemon already knows the issue is in_progress'. Thread 3999033805.
